description: This file defines the A2UIHandler class responsible for managing the interaction with a web-based UI component in an Android application, including URL resolution, readiness checking, message decoding, and message application via JavaScript evaluation.

classes.name: A2UIHandler
classes.description: Handles interactions with the A2UI web component, such as URL resolution, readiness checks, and message decoding and applying.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is a trusted canvas action URL.

methods.name: resolveA2uiHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the A2UI host URL based on provided node and operator URLs.

methods.name: ensureA2uiReady
methods.description: Ensures that the A2UI component is fully loaded and ready, with retries and delays.

methods.name: decodeA2uiMessages
methods.description: Decodes messages received from the A2UI, handling JSON parsing and validation.

methods.name: validateA2uiV0_8
methods.description: Validates that the message conforms to A2UI version 0.8 standards.

methods.name: a2uiApplyMessagesJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for applying messages to the A2UI component.
